target_skill_summary.onset: Strongest discrimination & calibration skill (14D ROC-AUC=0.9494, PR-AUC=0.9392, Brier=0.0847 vs Climatology 0.2477, +65.8% Brier skill; XGB Brier=0.0574, LSTM Brier=0.1484).
target_skill_summary.false_onset: Moderate discrimination but weak calibration on noisy transition weeks (14D ROC-AUC=0.578, PR-AUC=0.1419, Calibrated Brier=0.1929 vs Climatology 0.1099; XGB Brier=0.2633, LSTM Brier=0.2245).
target_skill_summary.dry_spell: Moderate discrimination skill (14D ROC-AUC=0.9068, PR-AUC=0.9015, Brier=0.1012 vs Climatology 0.2588, +60.9% Brier skill; test prevalence=49.1%, n_pos=1049).
target_skill_summary.heavy_rain: Weakest discrimination due to extreme convective localization & rare-event prevalence (14D ROC-AUC=0.5533, PR-AUC=0.0829, Calibrated Brier=0.0833 vs Climatology 0.0781; test positive rate=8.5%, n_pos=182).
